The Porto stay was refunded already, less its one night fee, and I missed the Ryanair to Faro (FRR70A). I want to go home: please cancel the Lisbon to Nice flight LHR70B, I know Lufthansa keeps 84 EUR of the Light fare, and the Nice hotel AMF-R70C even with its 345 EUR late fee, and move my Delta flight home DLR70D to DL243 from Lisbon on 31 October, I can pay up to 200 USD more. I have Allianz through you and the hospital papers: refund what you can and claim the rest from Allianz, the Ryanair too. elena.brooks@example.com, card 6114.
